requirement.description: The base NotifyBase class is missing essential URL parsing functionality that many plugins rely on. Several plugins fail because they don't properly implement the parse_url() method or don't correctly handle URL parsing parameters.
requirement.contract: Ensure that the base NotifyBase class properly implements URL parsing functionality including: 1. Complete parse_url() method implementation that handles all standard URL parameters 2. Proper handling of qsd (query string dictionary) parameters 3. Consistent behavior for URL parsing across all plugins 4. Correct implementation of URL parsing validation and error handling
requirement.acceptance: - All plugin URL parsing tests pass (e.g., test_plugin_dapnet_urls, test_plugin_office365_urls) - The test_apprise_async test passes - URL parsing consistency across all plugins is maintained

requirement.description: Missing or incomplete service_url and setup_url attributes in many plugin classes. These are required for URL validation and plugin identification but are often missing or incorrectly implemented.
requirement.contract: All plugins must define: 1. service_url attribute with valid service URL 2. setup_url attribute with valid setup/help URL 3. Both attributes must be properly initialized in plugin classes 4. Attributes should be accessible through the base class interface
requirement.acceptance: - Plugin URL validation tests pass (e.g., test_plugin_dapnet_urls, test_plugin_office365_urls) - No AssertionError related to missing URL attributes - All plugins can properly generate and validate their URLs

requirement.description: Inconsistent implementation of the async_notify() method in the base class. The async notification functionality fails because the implementation doesn't properly handle async operations or is missing entirely in some cases.
requirement.contract: The base NotifyBase class must provide a robust async_notify() implementation that: 1. Properly handles asynchronous operations 2. Uses asyncio.get_event_loop() correctly 3. Implements proper error handling for async operations 4. Maintains compatibility with all plugin implementations 5. Ensures all plugins can leverage async functionality
requirement.acceptance: - The test_apprise_async test passes - Async notification functionality works correctly - No TypeError or AttributeError related to async operations - All plugins can successfully execute async_notify() calls

requirement.description: Missing or incorrect implementation of the __len__() method in several plugins. This affects batch processing and notification counting functionality.
requirement.contract: Plugins must implement __len__() method to: 1. Return the correct number of targets/notifications 2. Account for batch processing behavior 3. Handle batch size calculations properly 4. Maintain consistency with base class expectations
requirement.acceptance: - Tests that rely on object length checking pass - Batch processing functionality works correctly - Notification counting behaves as expected

requirement.description: Missing or incomplete implementation of the url_identifier property in plugin classes. This affects unique identifier generation for URL comparisons and caching.
requirement.contract: All plugins must properly implement url_identifier property to: 1. Return unique identifiers that distinguish different configurations 2. Exclude target-specific information (only authentication/protocol info) 3. Be consistent with base class expectations 4. Support proper caching and comparison operations
requirement.acceptance: - URL identifier generation works correctly - No failures related to identifier uniqueness - Caching and comparison functionality works as expected
